evaluation_spec.answer_rate_gate: per schema, T answer rate >= C answer rate - 2.0 points, checked before accuracy is read; failure counts as a guardrail failure
evaluation_spec.checkpoint: final adapter of the fixed schedule only; no intermediate checkpoint is ever evaluated on the gate
evaluation_spec.confirmation_claims: none: lower bound > +5 is not a gate of this screen

also_reported: function-level P(at least one valid killing candidate)
downstream.diversity_guardrail: mean exact-unique ratio may fall by at most 10% relative
downstream.kill_at_8: canonical production generation (successor settings: 8 candidates, frozen temperature/top-p/seed) on the gate functions; reported with a paired cluster bootstrap; not gating
downstream.validity_guardrail: original guardrail: mean per-candidate reference validity may fall by at most 3.0 points (point estimate, T - C)

labels: composite intervention: value-only masking plus reduced supervised-token mass
evaluation_spec.looks: exactly one gate look per arm; the analysis refuses to run twice

outcomes.harm: an upper bound < 0 under either schema, or any gate/guardrail fails
outcomes.inconclusive_power: anything else; never rejects the intervention
outcomes.promising: answer-rate gates and guardrails pass, lower bound > 0 under both schemas, no schema sign flip

primary_mediator.contrast: treatment minus control, exactly paired items
primary_mediator.metric: fixed-input exact-output accuracy (assert CALL == ANSWER passes on the reference)
